sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate correctly targets ships, requires exactly one xsd:date construction contract date as applicability evidence, and applies the inclusive 2021-01-01 threshold without introducing a redundant applicability boolean.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove nltl:urI2RevisionApplicability and the true/false sh:or branches; this is a needless convenience applicability boolean. Encode applicability directly from the ship-owned nltl:constructionContractDate: select nltl:ship nodes with an xsd:date value greater than or equal to 2021-01-01 as the applicable population, without treating ships before that date as violations.

Do not add or require urI2RevisionApplicability, since ship class and construction date already determine applicability.

The candidate correctly targets ships, requires exactly one xsd:date construction contract date as applicability evidence, and applies the inclusive 2021-01-01 threshold without introducing a redundant applicability boolean.
